== Title ==
<span lang="ja">貴様の失策につきあうのもこれが最後だ</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">場にベイダーが出ている場合に、相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使用する。戦闘に参加している運命数＜6の相手のリーダーを目標とする。相手が戦闘に勝利しなかったなら、目標は没収値＝0となり、即座にロストする。オゼルであれば除外カードとなる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「ベイダー卿。艦隊は光速を脱し、これより……うわっ……うぐ……ぐえっ」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — You Have Failed Me For The Last Time.

'''Lore''' — Lord Vader. The fleet has left lightspeed, and from now... whoa... ugh... gueh.

'''Game text''' — If Vader is on table, play just after the opponent declares a battle. Target an opponent's leader in that battle with destiny less than 6. If the opponent did not win, the target's forfeit becomes 0 and it is immediately lost. If it is Ozzel, it becomes an excluded card.

Title is a translated movie line, not a literal English title. Game text targets destiny ＜6; English targets ability < 6. Ozzel is an excluded card (除外カード), matching English out of play.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-youhavefailedmeforthelasttime.gif|Original English face]], [[You Have Failed Me For The Last Time]].</ref>
